narrative.title: The Cold-Room Contamination Sweep
narrative.scenario: A cold room stores produce in a grid of crates: spoiled units, fresh units, and empty slots. Every minute the spoilage jumps to any fresh crate sharing an edge with a spoiled one. The floor manager must know the exact minute the last fresh unit goes down — or hear that some shelf corner is sealed off from every spoiled crate and will never turn.
narrative.inputFormat: An m x n grid where 0 is an empty slot, 1 a fresh crate, and 2 a spoiled crate.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the minimum number of minutes until no fresh crate remains, or -1 if some fresh crate can never be reached.

testCases.explanation: The spoilage wave needs four minutes to crawl to the far corner.
Nothing fresh is present, so the clock never needs to start.

hintLevels: Level 1: Multiple spoiled crates spread at once — this is a simultaneous race, not one seed.
Level 2: Seed the queue with every spoiled crate, then expand ring by ring; each ring is one minute.
Level 3: Keep a live count of fresh crates; if it never reaches zero when the queue empties, some are sealed off — answer -1.
